limitations: No independent reproduction of cited paper results.
Unreviewed entries deliberately retain null analysis rather than importing user seed claims as facts.
Current product-path paired-assistance gate remains open.
Triads, edge endpoints, Wasm packaging and new compiler contracts are not installed by this index.
